508:t_1:173.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm sorry for speaking out of turn. But...」

508:t_1:175.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Come to think of it, we've known each other a long time. I suppose I can't fool those eyes of yours.」

508:t_1:176.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Is it because of $$シャア・アズナブル$$?」

508:t_1:178.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There seems to be no small unrest among the soldiers as well.」

508:t_1:179.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ジンネマン$$, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$ and the others defected too. And on top of that, their former leader, who abandoned them, suddenly returns...」

508:t_1:180.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「He may have made such a blatant move as surrendering in order to break us down from within.」

508:t_1:181.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「He is not that kind of man. Your Excellency $$ハマーン$$ knows that better than anyone.」

508:t_1:184.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「During the $$多元戦争$$, when I was about to appear before him for the first time, back when he was the representative of the $$エゥーゴ$$, you told me this.」

508:t_1:185.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「'He will surely not tolerate your existence... But that is because of the distortion called $$ジオン$$, which needed a decoy for $$ミネバ・ザビ$$.'」

508:t_1:186.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now that you mention it, that did happen...」

508:t_1:187.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I thought then that you understand him, Your Excellency.」

508:t_1:188.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...He could not forgive that distortion... my way of doing things, so he made himself leader and tried to rebuild $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

508:t_1:189.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But in the end, he threw away his own responsibility. I cannot forgive that.」

508:t_1:192.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You are lying to your own heart, Your Excellency. In truth, what he did...」

508:t_1:193.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You've got a nerve, girl.」

508:t_1:195.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...It seems I let you see too much of the world's underside.」

508:t_1:197.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Thanks to that, you've come to sense things you needn't know... things you needn't even see.」

508:t_1:199.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$, too, went back to $$ジオン$$ half-resigned to death, to settle what he had done.」

508:t_1:200.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I, too, must do what I have to.」

508:t_1:202.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Sorry. It seems I won't be able to attend tomorrow's meeting.」

508:t_1:204.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I thank you for going along with my doings.」

508:t_1:205.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Tomorrow you will attend a meeting with the colony autonomy organization representatives, from 16:00.」

508:t_1:207.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「There's nothing to worry about. I'll handle the substantive talks, so all you need to do is sit there.」

508:t_1:209.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You may be tired, but you will do it. Even if you are a decoy, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ needs $$ミネバ・ザビ$$.」

508:t_1:210.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Isn't it you, Your Excellency, who is tired?」

508:t_2:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. We welcome you.」

508:t_2:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Of course, it is not only I personally who will cooperate with $c. The forces that side with me have already defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

508:t_2:7.en:

508:t_2:8.en:

508:t_2:9.en:
